status: jointly-reviewed scoped source-reference; creative and operating proposals remain separate
scope: Source comparison and protected boundaries only. The first route is incomplete and under CR-F01..08 revision. This record does not adopt its Floor68 placement, prospective710AE scheduling, or pre-Proof-War frame.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: First Choir formation and assault — contested timing
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The original presents unnamed chords, invitation/formation and active seal repair before the direct scarlet-fire assault opening the Sundering. The owner says the First Choir arose in response to Asmodeus attacking Calanthir.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Owner intent is recorded; exact event/awakening timing remains unresolved. Do not restore the withdrawn no-agency-before-assault or one-to-one Harmony mapping.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Pillar realms mature after the Sundering
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Planes Ascendant opening explicitly follows the Sundering and describes four differentiating realms; the next chapter begins with all four contributing to the Weave.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: This is relative narrative order, not a numbered-year or floor mapping.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Watch Convocation and aspirant gates
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: During the Lucent Interregnum, nascent divinity leads the Choir to open access to seven long-vacant Thrones. A gate appears at an unnamed Mirrorsage monastery library.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The Thrones are described as older than this opening. The monastery has no supplied numbered floor; current gate availability is not selected.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Candescent Loom and Weave refraction
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: After the Argent Gate shines, the narrative describes small acts leaving visible intention records, called the Candescent Loom.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: A source episode does not automatically make every intention visible through current spells or provide a universal moral detection rule.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Pact sentience
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Accumulated resonance gives the Pact a will distinct from a god or Choir chord in the narrative.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not use this development to identify the Heartcell builder or assign a calendar date.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Archon sites and living records
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Within the Pact-sentience chapter, Valcendyr forms the Oath Archive in Crystal Bastion and Quorilith establishes Library of Shifting Sigils.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: These are source-established events, with no chosen present-campaign access or Equation holdings.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Shardfall and Silver Prism Year
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Moment of First Scatter is called Shardfall; the ensuing Silver Prism Year has elastic length measured by transformed lives. Sixth Archive cartographers meet at Sigil Navigators Library.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not convert the Year into one standard 400-day year or treat Sixth Archive as Floor 6. The library alias remains unresolved.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Epoch of Chosen Threads
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Silver Prism Year closes; scholars call the transition the Epoch of Chosen Threads. Community story keys can manifest resource-bearing Dungeon enclaves in the source.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Epoch terminology supplies no fixed elapsed duration or automatically usable new portal mechanic.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Counter-expression and Unbound Academy
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Matrix broadcast prompts the Spiral Integral counter-expression. Quiet Wells later collapse and the Matrix equation fades; after the Sunrise of Chosen Threads a council builds the Unbound Academy.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The narrative subsequently develops a renewed threat; this episode is not proof that all Oblivion danger has permanently ended or that Academy access is guaranteed now.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Quiet Masquerade and Citadel of Many Echoes
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Following the Masquerade confrontation, the Academy and Yieldheart guilds build the Citadel at Crystalfall Summit. Its galleries preserve songs, prototypes and restricted chronicles; later the Matrix develops deliberate calculus.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not merge the Citadel with a numbered dungeon floor or assume Selene’s foundation journal is freely accessible.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Matrix Horizon and imminent campaign
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Dawn Loom concert identifies the approaching Matrix Horizon. A later chapter places its arrival on the twentieth eve after the Citadel Vigil.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The passage gives a relative marker, not a bridge to AE dating. Do not equate the Vigil with the Citadel’s founding date without evidence.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: High Chancel ascent
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The fellowship ascends a ladder of living light toward the High Chancel to confront the Matrix edge.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The route is not a normal descent to Floor 97 or Floor 100 merely because the same saga discusses the Dungeon.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Silent Library and Final Ledger
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Inside the Matrix, the Silent Library tries to reduce cognition to zero. Memory-rope and song stabilize its books; the Final Ledger is answered and blanks before the walls open onward.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Keep the encounter’s transformation. An untouched reusable library, a fixed floor or guaranteed access is not supplied.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Shard of Absolute Rest, victory and Charter
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The black Shard of Absolute Rest splits; the Matrix curve scatters and Null breaches seal. The Charter of Infinite Yield follows. Ul nak’s dream recedes rather than vanishing; Stillness may try again in ages.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not identify this shattered shard with Q6’s focusing crystal, or convert receding dream into death of the survivor/Old God. No identity bridge is established.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Explicit post-Proof-War epilogue
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Movement One explicitly places its scene after the Proof War. Later movements give the Spiral cosmograph and Choir chorus around the Charter.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The document’s later setting does not select the current campaign epoch. Map symbols and coils are not numbered dungeon floors.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Epilogue toolbox and express portability
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Dungeon seeds are headed after Infinite Yield, and three arcs continue beyond the epilogue. P324 expressly permits tables and relics to be used independently of the saga or in multi-era campaigns.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Preserve both original placement and permission to adapt. Portability does not choose a floor, public truth, chronology or automatic mechanical replacement. Reuse the existing seventeen EPI groups.

sourceBoundaries: Preserve original87AE FirstCycle and710AE CurrentCycle. Their623-year gap has remainder3 under an assumed uninterrupted ten-year phase. No supplied bridge resolves it; no date is edited.
Primordial Cycles are qualitative ages, distinct from the400-day mortal year, ten-year mortal rotation and operational Opening/Horn clocks. No unprovided conversion is inferred.
Printed chapter/bullet order does not prove every temporal or causal dependency. Relative original-story sequence remains useful with explicit limits.
Owner FirstChoir attack-response intent controls. Preserve the original nascent-chord/formation passages and the unresolved formal timing seam. Do not restore withdrawn one-to-one Harmony mapping.
The nine-verse statement and seven virtue benefits remain as printed. VariableOmega is named, but no additional virtue/benefit or missing verse is invented.
Keep original ShardofAbsoluteRest andQ6focusingcrystal distinct until explicitly linked. Preserve producesORexposes, no guaranteed kill/drop.
Keep OldGod/survivor/Ulnak/eleventhshard/Heartcellbuilder/Binding/Interstice identities unmerged. FailedSixthGate remains the reliable public expedition ceiling.
OriginalP324 permits explicit independent/multi-era adaptation. It does not automatically place libraries or activate EPI01–17 mechanics.

issues.subject: Current campaign anchor
issues.currentDisposition: RESOLVE OPERATING TREATMENT; CAMPAIGN FRAME REMAINS A PROVISIONAL CHOICE
issues.decision: NEW PROVISIONAL DESIGN: Treat the current campaign as its own present Opening anchored to the printed 710 AE Current Cycle claim for mortal scheduling. The original forward saga remains true source history/potential history but is not presumed completed, publicly known, or mapped to the current party unless the Director selects a campaign-frame relation. Public reliable knowledge remains capped at the failed Sixth Gate.
issues.unresolvedOwnerChoice: Choose the campaign-frame relation before an adventure requires a fact that depends on it: (A) pre-Proof-War current campaign, recommended default; (B) contemporary-with-forward-saga; (C) post-Proof-War adaptation. Any choice must preserve Q6 public-reliability and identity seams.

issues.subject: Primordial ages, mortal years and clocks
issues.decision: Primordial Cycles remain qualitative ages with no fixed conversion to mortal years. Mortal calendar claims (400-day year; ten-year rotation) and Opening/Horn operational clocks remain separate units. No bridge is inferred among primordial age language, AE dates, Opening clocks, Horn clocks, or elastic celestial intervals.

issues.subject: 87 AE / 710 AE cadence tension
issues.currentDisposition: NEW PROVISIONAL OPERATING CALENDAR; HISTORICAL PHASE OFFSET UNRESOLVED
issues.decision: Preserve both printed dates. For current play, anchor the present ten-year rotation prospectively at 710 AE instead of extrapolating an uninterrupted cadence backward from 87 AE. The 623-year gap and remainder 3 are retained as a source tension, not silently repaired.
issues.assumptions: This treatment assumes the 710 AE line is the best explicit present-cycle scheduling anchor and does not assert that every earlier Cycle followed an uninterrupted phase from 87 AE.
ownerAlternatives: Keep both dates and later author an explicit calendar interruption/intercalation/phase reset.
Correct 710 AE to a date congruent with an uninterrupted cadence from 87 AE (e.g. 707 AE); this edits printed source and therefore requires owner choice.
Correct/reinterpret 87 AE instead; also an owner source-edit choice.
Define First Cycle and Current Cycle as differently scoped events despite shared word Cycle; requires explicit lore wording.

issues.subject: World history, source sequence and Q6
issues.decision: World outline order, dated appendix claims, original Cosmology sequence and Q6 Director truth remain separate evidence layers. Printed bullet/chapter order is presentation evidence but not automatic proof of every causal dependency. Do not identify First Light with a specific First Song instant or merge eleventh shard, survivor, Ul'nak, Old God, Heartcell builder, Binding or Interstice.

issues.subject: Crystal identity and narrative victory
issues.decision: The original Shard of Absolute Rest and Q6 focusing crystal remain distinct records. Floor 100 may produce OR expose the focusing crystal; do not convert that into guaranteed defeat/drop or identity with the shattered source object.

issues.subject: Epilogue portability versus adoption
issues.decision: P324 authorizes adaptation of tables/relics independent of the core saga or across eras. That permission supports authored adaptations such as the provisional Wax Library placement, but does not activate EPI01–17 mechanics, motif time-halving, Null Veil cures, borrowed-feature benefits, or any supersession of newer current rules.

issues.subject: Website and companion timeline assertions
issues.currentDisposition: SOURCE CLAIMS RETAINED; PUBLIC TEXT NEEDS QUALIFICATION AT DISPLAY
issues.decision: The saved website/companion timeline copies are source-derived claims, not independent witnesses. Recommended reader-visible qualification: label the 87 AE and 710 AE entries as preserved setting chronicle dates whose exact uninterrupted Cycle phase is unresolved; label Level 97 Binding material as restricted/legendary and subordinate current reliable public knowledge to the failed Sixth Gate boundary. Source inspection is not release/render validation.

issues.subject: First Choir timing and chorus count
issues.currentDisposition: OWNER CAUSAL INTENT CONTROLS; EXACT MICRO-CHRONOLOGY AND VERSE ACCOUNTING OPEN
issues.decision: Owner correction controls the causal intent: the First Choir arose in response to Asmodeus attacking Calan'thir, and later virtues derive from that resonance. Preserve the original paragraphs showing seven nascent chords before the direct P39 assault and their invitation/formation scene; treat 'nascent chords', 'formal First Choir role/awakening', and the attack-response causal statement as distinguishable until the exact P35/P39 chronology is owner-edited. Do not restore a one-to-one Harmony mapping.
issues.nineVersesTreatment: O279 says nine verses and 'one for each virtue plus the binding Variable Omega', while O280 supplies seven named virtue motif benefits. Seven virtue motifs are mechanically evidenced; Variable Omega is named in the song statement; one further verse/accounting element is not supplied. Preserve the mismatch. Do not invent an eighth virtue, an unnamed motif benefit, or call it a transcription error.
issues.ownerChoiceIfEditing: Either (A) leave the literary seam explicit, recommended now; (B) move/retime the formal Choir awakening after the direct assault; or (C) define 'attack' broadly as the hostile rupture/escalation preceding P39. B/C require owner-authored clarification.
